sanskrit_verse:
पूर्वप्रवृत्तम् उत्सन्नम् अपृष्ट्वा स्वामिनं तु यः
सेतुं प्रवर्तयेत् कश्चिन् न स तत्फलभाग् भवेत्
transliteration:
pūrvapravṛttam utsannam apṛṣṭvā svāminaṃ tu yaḥ
setuṃ pravartayet kaścin na sa tatphalabhāg bhavet
sph_interpretive_translation: One who initiates an action that was previously abandoned without consulting the rightful authority does not become entitled to its fruits.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority as the foundation of lawful initiation
Causation rooted in consent and consultation
Restoration logic via alignment with established order
Consciousness alignment through adherence to source-authority
executable_legal_axioms: IF action.initiated = TRUE AND prior_action.status = 'abandoned' AND consulted_authority = FALSE THEN entitlement_to_fruit = FALSE
IF agent.authority_verification = null THEN action.fruit_distribution.rights = VOID
IF process.sequence.integrity = compromised THEN outcome.entitlement.validity = nullified
IF responsibility.assumption ≠ capacity.alignment THEN consequence.reversal = automatic
IF dharma.path.consultation.omitted = TRUE THEN fruit.access = denied
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any act undertaken without requisite consultation of competent authority after a prior abandonment shall be deemed legally void ab initio. The threshold of responsibility includes verification of procedural continuity and authoritative consent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causal integrity requires both knowledge and consent from the source authority. Anupūrvaśaḥ indicates sequential dependence on lawful antecedents. Responsibility aligns proportionally with conscious participation in sanctioned order. No punitive inference arises; only disentitlement occurs naturally due to procedural misalignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-initiate action only upon verified consultation
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Acknowledge omission and seek corrective alignment
Capacity Restoration: Engage rightful authority for revalidation
Integrity Reintegration: Document full sequence for future reference
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Sole Source of Dharma. Fruit entitlement flows only through rightful consultation and sustained alignment with established authority. Justice restores lawful sequence; consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Non-punitive reality prevails.
